question: Should the named LiteLLM onboarding choice grow an interactive proxy base-URL and model-discovery step, or should remote LiteLLM users be directed to the existing Custom Provider flow?
rationale: Both options can address the report, but the choice changes provider-owned onboarding UX, credentialed endpoint probing, and the boundary between bundled LiteLLM setup and generic OpenAI-compatible custom endpoints.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have `litellm-api-key` ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while preserving the existing non-interactive `--custom-base-url` behavior.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep LiteLLM as localhost/default-model setup and update prompts/docs so remote proxy users choose Custom Provider for URL and model entry.

options.title: Defer Dynamic Discovery
options.body: Leave this open until the broader credentialed provider catalog and `/v1/models` discovery policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have `litellm-api-key` ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while preserving the existing non-interactive `--custom-base-url` behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history on LiteLLM pluginization and the narrower carried-forward non-interactive setup fix.
